examples.english: Let us now simply bring forward Paul’s testimony, which says: to unite us into one faith, one divinity, one kingdom, because the Trinity is immutable. For he said: ‘There is one God and one mediator between God and humanity, Jesus Christ, the Son of God the Father, one Holy Spirit, one Catholic Church, one resurrection of the dead in time.’ Thus, Paul said, ‘[…] you have fully grasped the mystery of the Holy Trinity.’ One among you said the Word is a creature; another said the Holy Spirit and the body of Christ are creatures; another, however, killed the soul and body of Christ […].

examples.coptic: ⲁϥⲟⲩⲱϣⲃ ⲛⲁⲩ ⲛϭⲓⲓⲏⲥⲟⲩⲥ . ϫⲉⲁⲓⲧⲥⲁⲃⲱⲧⲛ ⲉϩⲁϩ ⲛϩⲱⲃ ⲉⲛⲁⲛⲟⲩⲉⲃⲟⲗ ϩⲓⲧⲙⲡⲁⲉⲓⲱⲧ ⲉⲧⲃⲉⲁϣ ⲙⲙⲟⲟⲩ ⲛϩⲱⲃ **ⲧⲉⲧⲛ**ϩⲓ ⲱⲛⲉ ⲉⲣⲟⲓ .
examples.english: Jesus answered them, 'I have shown you many good works from my Father. For which of those works do you stone me?'

examples.coptic: ⲧⲁⲓ ⲧⲉ ⲧϩⲉ ⲙⲡⲟⲩⲣⲟⲧ **ⲧⲉⲧⲛ**ⲙⲙⲁⲓ ⲉⲉⲩⲁⲅⲅⲉⲗⲓⲍⲉ ϩⲱⲧⲧⲏⲩⲧⲛ ⲛⲏⲧⲛ ⲛⲉⲧϩⲛ ϩⲣⲱⲙⲏ .
examples.english: So, as much as is in me, I am eager to preach the Good News to you also who are in Rome.

examples.coptic: ⲙⲙⲁ ⲇⲉ ⲉⲧϫⲟⲥⲉ ⲙⲡⲉϥϥⲓⲧⲟⲩ ⲙⲙⲁⲩ ⲛⲉⲣⲉⲡⲗⲁⲟⲥ ⲟⲛ ⲣⲑⲩⲥⲓⲁ ⲁⲩⲱ ⲛⲉⲩϯϩⲏⲛⲉ ⲉϩⲣⲁⲓ ϩⲓϫⲱⲟⲩ ⲛⲧⲟϥ ⲡⲉⲛⲧⲁϥⲕⲱⲧ ⲛⲧⲡⲩⲗⲏ ⲙⲡⲏⲓ ⲙⲡϫⲟⲉⲓⲥ **ⲧⲉⲧⲛ**ϩⲙⲡⲥⲁ ⲛⲧⲡⲉ
examples.english: Nevertheless he took not away the high places: as yet the people sacrificed and burnt incense on the high places. He built the upper gate of the Lord's house.
